'''Magra-Su''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] living on [[Voss]]. She oversaw the Mystic Trials at the [[Shrine of Healing]], facing all potentials and judging their actions at the Trials.<ref name="TOR" />
